headlines.line: The intrusion was discovered within the past month or so during work to upgrade the system, people familiar with the matter told Reuters.

headlines.line: Deutsche Bank research analysts provided an assessment of the new European Central Bank (ECB) board members, anticipating a shift in policy tone.

headlines.title: Zegna strengthens supply chain with new footwear and leather goods hub in Sala Baganza
headlines.line: Ermenegildo Zegna is expanding its production capabilities by establishing a new facility dedicated to footwear and leather goods in Sala Baganza.

headlines.line: CIBC Asset Management has finalized the termination of several ETF Series, including the CIBC 2026 Investment Grade Bond Funds and Sustainable Investment Strategies.

headlines.line: The Disney+ original series 'The Remarried Empress' has become the most-watched Korean original title in the platform's history.

headlines.title: SK hynix Doubles Daily Share Buyback Volume
headlines.line: SK hynix has increased its daily share buyback order volume to approximately 700,000 shares, up from 350,000, in an effort to support its stock price following a significant decline.

headlines.title: Disney Issues Cease-and-Desist to ByteDance Over AI Copyright Concerns
headlines.line: The Walt Disney Company has reportedly sent a cease-and-desist letter to ByteDance, alleging the unauthorized use of Disney characters to train its Seedance 2.0 AI video generator.

headlines.title: BlackRock Increases Voting Rights Stake in J Sainsbury PLC

headlines.title: BlackRock Files Major Holdings Notification for Adtran Holdings, Inc.

headlines.title: Salesforce Releases Global Consumer Research on AI Adoption and Data Privacy
headlines.line: Salesforce published new consumer research findings highlighting trends in AI-driven shopping behavior and evolving customer attitudes toward data privacy.

headlines.line: SK Hynix has indicated that its production capacity for 2029 is nearly fully booked, with memory shortages expected to persist into 2030.

headlines.line: Toyota Motor Corporation reported a decline in its total group production and sales for the month of October 2026.

headlines.line: LVMH has declared an interim dividend of €5.50 per share for the 2026 fiscal year, payable in December.

summary:
**Market summary, 2026-11-27 (data as of 13:33 UTC)**

US equities were mixed in the 2026-11-25 session. SPY fell 0.29% and QQQ 0.65%, with technology (XLK, -0.83%) the weakest sector. The Russell 2000 rose 0.65%, and materials led sectors at +2.07%. USO gained 3.29%, gold rose 0.61%, and long Treasuries (TLT) rose 0.92%. The dollar index was roughly flat.

Economic data were mixed. GDP came in at 4.3% against 3.4% expected, and initial jobless claims were 189K against 201K expected. Durable goods orders rose 0.2% against 0.7% expected. Crude inventories rose 1.109M barrels against a 2.000M build expected.

Pre-market indications for today, a shortened Thanksgiving session, show SPY up 1.68% and QQQ up 2.33%. These thin prints may not reflect actual trading levels. Notable headlines include a reported breach of the U.S. Air Force Cloud One platform and a Disney cease-and-desist letter to ByteDance.
